use_cases.title: Engineering Planning & Code Review Cycle
use_cases.description: The combination of review, coding, analysis and planning indicates a structured engineering workflow where code changes are planned, analyzed, written, and then reviewed.

use_cases.title: Contract Review
use_cases.description: Legal reviews incoming contracts such as supplier agreements and NDAs against the company's standard positions, flagging clauses that differ and unusual liability, termination or data terms, and suggesting redlines. The output is a summary of issues with proposed changes.

use_cases.title: Onboarding Paperwork
use_cases.description: HR prepares the paperwork for a new starter: contract details, the right-to-work and equipment checklist, system access requests and the first-week plan. The output is a completed onboarding pack for the new starter and their manager.

use_cases.title: Building Integrated Reporting and Developer Tools
use_cases.description: Users are orchestrating multiple connectors to build internal tools: such as unified marketing performance reports and developer portals: that pull and combine data from several external systems.

use_cases.title: Cross-Tool Engineering Documentation Workflow
use_cases.description: People are pulling context from issue trackers, code repos, email, and shared drives to produce structured artifacts such as RFCs, decision records, and invoice reconciliations.

use_cases.title: AI Code Review Assistant
use_cases.description: Engineers ask Claude to review a pull request or a set of code changes before merging: it reads the diff, points out bugs, risky changes and missing tests, and suggests fixes. The output is a set of review comments and, often, corrected code.

use_cases.title: Support and customer conversation summarisation
use_cases.description: Users summarise high volumes of support tickets and customer call transcripts to quickly surface key issues and renewal risk signals.

use_cases.title: Applying engineering rigor to business analysis
use_cases.description: Engineering-style skills like code review and systematic debugging are being invoked alongside collaborative doc writing to structure ad hoc business analyses, such as pricing experiments and escalation triage, that don't yet have a standard process.

use_cases.title: Structured document drafting at scale
use_cases.description: People across nearly every department use templated drafting to produce standardized artifacts like design docs, runbooks, feedback summaries, and risk reviews, then substitute in specifics for their situation.

use_cases.title: Board-Pack Prep
use_cases.description: Finance prepares the monthly board pack: the month's results, variance against budget and key metrics in the board's standard sections, with commentary on what changed and why. The output is a draft board pack ready for the finance director to review.

use_cases.title: Campaign Brief Automation
use_cases.description: Marketing writes the brief for a new campaign: objective, audience, key messages, channels, timings and budget, drawn from the campaign request and past results. The output is a campaign brief in the team's standard format, ready for the agency or the team to work from.

use_cases.title: Meeting notes
use_cases.description: Engineers turn meeting transcripts or rough notes into structured notes: decisions made, actions with owners and dates, and open questions. The output is a short set of notes shared with the attendees.
